# afx

afx is a fast, local coding agent for the terminal, written in Zig.

Canonical links:
- Repository: https://github.com/evan-luther-pf/afx
- Documentation: https://evan-luther-pf.github.io/afx/
- Releases: https://github.com/evan-luther-pf/afx/releases
- Changelog: https://github.com/evan-luther-pf/afx/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
- Issues: https://github.com/evan-luther-pf/afx/issues

Install:
1. Download the archive for the current platform from the latest GitHub release.
2. Extract the archive.
3. Put the afx binary on PATH, for example at ~/.local/bin/afx.

Build from source:
git clone https://github.com/evan-luther-pf/afx.git
cd afx
zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseSafe
./zig-out/bin/afx

Common commands:
- afx: start an interactive session in the current directory
- afx ask "prompt": run one request
- afx providers: manage providers and credentials
- afx sessions: list saved sessions
- afx session resume last: resume the latest workspace session
- afx status --json: print machine-readable runtime and provider status
- afx upgrade: install the latest stable GitHub release
- afx upgrade --channel dev: follow the moving development prerelease

Interactive commands:
- /help: list commands and shortcuts
- /model: choose a model
- /providers: manage accounts and keys
- /sessions: resume saved work
- /settings: change preferences
- /plan: inspect and prepare a reviewable plan before implementation

Configuration:
- Private settings and runtime state: ~/.afx/
- Project defaults: .afx.json
- Personal skills: ~/.afx/skills/
- Project skills: .afx/skills/
- Personal agent profiles: ~/.afx/agents/
- Project agent profiles: .afx/agents/
- MCP configuration: ~/.afx/mcp.json

Capabilities:
- Local file inspection and mutation
- Snapshot-bound hashline editing with original line anchors, syntax blocks, multi-file preflight, stale recovery, clipboard registers, moves, and removal
- Captured commands and persistent terminal sessions
- LSP definitions, references, diagnostics, symbols, code actions, and renames
- DAP debugger sessions
- Public web search and page reading with citations
- MCP tools, resources, prompts, and completion
- Skills, images, memory, todos, checkpoints, and task agents
- Saved and branching sessions

Permissions:
- auto: routine work proceeds; unresolved sensitive actions receive bounded review
- ask: sensitive actions request user approval
- yolo: no afx permission prompts; use only in a trusted environment

Updates are served only from evan-luther-pf/afx GitHub Releases. Stable builds use versioned releases. Development builds use the moving dev prerelease.
